architecture.proposal_consensus: arithmetic mean of two scaled route logits
architecture.summary_route_relations: per-proposal neighbor mean, maximum, and minimum

protocol.data_scope: fresh project-owned procedural graph scenes only; no Chandler, Generalization, private or article images, external datasets, V28 fixture bytes, or V28 case identities
protocol.defect_class: V28 passed every visible-selection scene at five thresholds but its one truth-hidden public run passed only 188 of 192 scenes, with three false regions and two misses at the selected threshold
protocol.isolated_change: replace the single relational proposal route with two independently initialized project-owned routes: pairwise attention and permutation-invariant relation summaries; train both from scratch and average only their proposal logits while emitting deterministic geometry roles
